text:
maria: Heads up — during the 13:00 UTC rollout we saw ~30% of eu-west-1 Dedicated pool traffic fall back to eu-west-2 due to AZ-b NIC saturation. Latency + cost spike.
lee: Do we have the router logs / metrics? what triggered cross-AZ vs AZ-local fallback?
maria: Quick grep of router logs: ```FALLBACK reason=egress_saturation az=euw1-b dest=euw2-a code=FALLBACK_CROSS_AZ count=1873```
ash: tagging @sam for routing policy visibility.
sam: I pulled the policy: our soft-affinity prefill threshold is 15% and egress headroom check is noisy. If an AZ reports NIC queue > 85% we currently allow cross-AZ fallback immediately.
ash: That feels aggressive. Can we prefer same-AZ degrade (slower) before cross-AZ to avoid billed egress? :thinking_face:
jordan: Finance note — cross-AZ egress is billed. Quick estimate: last hour added ~3k GiB cross-AZ -> ~€0.10/GiB -> ~€300 for the hour. If this repeats daily it's material for some mid-market tenants.
maria: Proposed immediate mitigation: change fallback window to 5m local-only attempts before cross-AZ. Also tighten prefill so we don't pre-emptively spill. Rollout as canary then fast roll.
lee: I can open a router patch. Will add a config override: ```soft_affinity: prefill_pct: 0.10 egress_headroom_pct: 12 fallback: local_first_window_s: 300 allow_cross_az_if_unavailable: true```
sam: Sounds reasonable. Two asks: 1) add metric for "cross_az_fallback_rate" per tenant, 2) add cost-tagging to traces so we can attribute to customers.
jordan: I'll work on a rough cost-allocation mapping if you expose the trace tags. Give me a 24h dump.
ash: Ops bot note: deploy-bot: starting canary rollout of router v2.3.1 -> 1/10 targets.
deploy-bot: canary status: 1/10 success, 0 failures so far.
lee: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/router/pull/784 (contains config + telemetry)
maria: Good. For scope: this mitigates avoidable billed egress. We still need longer-term: NIC shaping + dedicated egress carveouts per-customer.
ash: Agree. Also we should surface this in Console as an "egress-risk" alert for Dedicated customers (so SEs can warn users).
sam: I'll add a dashboard tile and new alert rule (threshold + rate-of-change).
jordan: Once we have the dashboard, I can run a month projection. For now flagging Finance & Solutions teams.
maria: Thanks. We'll monitor the canary for 30m then escalate if any impact to SLO. @ash please be on standby for rollback. :thumbsup:
ash: ack.
ash: small follow-up: is there a plan for cost-sharing in contracts if we start introducing cross-AZ fallback by default?
jordan: short answer: not yet — we bill usage today. If cross-AZ becomes platform-controlled we should offer an opt-in "high-availability cross-AZ" add-on to avoid surprises.
lee: rolling the canary now. will post result in 10m.
maria: closing loop after monitoring window. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
